buildwright: Dependency-Health and Build-Failure Diagnostics

Source: R/buildwright-package.R
buildwright-package.Rd

buildwright scans installed libraries and renv lockfiles, builds a dependency graph, detects version conflicts and cycles, maps packages to their system requirements, and simulates installation order so that build failures can be caught before an install is attempted. See scan_library(), build_dep_graph(), detect_conflicts(), check_sysreqs(), simulate_install(), diagnose() and report().
